items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Who was in Fazola's band? Al Hurt, Julian Lane, Al's brother, Slick Hurt, and Johnny Ronica, myself.

ctx.x: Who was in the Owls when you joined?
Dan LeBlanc and Frank Netto. And Frank had changed to bass and Julian Lane played trombone and what's his name now? Trumpet player.
